svg.text: OpenMUPP on the YD-CH32V307VCT6 development board (BOARD=ydch32v307)
Probe signals only. 3.3 V targets only: no level shifters. SWDIO is one pin (PC11): no wire. Add the TCK link from PB13 to PC10.
Pin numbers and nets of the expansion headers P2 and P3 (2 x 24 pins) from the board schematic V1.0. Pin 1 has the square pad.
• USB2 (USB-C, PB6/PB7, USB high speed): connect the host here. USB1 (PA11/PA12) is not used.
• P4 (4-pin SWD header, PA13/PA14): SWD of the CH32V307 itself. Write the firmware here with a WCH-LinkE. Do not connect the target.
• Keep the microSD slot empty: PC10 and PC11 are also DAT2 and DAT3 of the card.
• Vref sense is optional: connect the target supply (3.3 V maximum) to PB0. No divider.
